conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: There are various types, such as direct cause-and-effect, where one cause has one effect, or complex relationships with multiple causes and effects.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, absolutely! This is known as a causal chain or a feedback loop, where an effect from one interaction becomes the cause for the next.
